title: An Additive MLP-GNN Framework for Characterizing Chemical and Structural Contributions to Aqueous Solubility
abstract: arXiv:2607.02212v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Aqueous solubility is a key property in early-stage drug discovery, but most predictive models merge physicochemical descriptors and molecular graph information into a single representation, obscuring whether a prediction is driven by global chemistry, molecular structure, or both. We present an additive deep-learning framework that keeps these two sources of information separate throughout training: physicochemical descriptors are encoded by a multilayer perceptron (the chemical branch) and molecular graph topology by a graph neural network (the structural branch), with the two outputs combined only at the prediction stage through an additive model with an optional multiplicative interaction. This design provides a direct decomposition of chemical and structural components that can be examined separately after training. translated_title: 一种用于表征化学与结构因素对水溶性贡献的加性MLP-GNN框架
translated_abstract: 水溶性是药物早期发现中的一项关键性质，但大多数预测模型将理化描述符与分子图信息合并为单一表示，从而掩盖了预测究竟是由全局化学性质、分子结构还是二者共同驱动的。我们提出了一种加性深度学习框架，在训练全过程中保持这两类信息源相互分离：理化描述符由多层感知机（化学分支）编码，分子图拓扑结构由图神经网络（结构分支）编码，两个输出仅在预测阶段通过带可选乘性交互项的加性模型进行组合。这种设计提供了化学成分与结构成分的直接分解，可在训练后分别加以考察。此外，通过在规模较大的AqSolDB数据集上进行预训练，并在规模较小的BigSolDB2数据集上进行微调，可进一步提升模型的预测性能。
tldr: 提出一种加性深度学习框架，将理化描述符（MLP化学分支）与分子图拓扑（GNN结构分支）分离建模并在预测阶段加性融合，实现了化学性质与分子结构对水溶性贡献的直接分解与可解释分析，并借助大库预训练加小库微调提升预测性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes an additive deep-learning framework that keeps physicochemical descriptors (MLP chemical branch) and molecular graph topology (GNN structural branch) separate until an additive prediction stage, enabling direct decomposition and interpretation of chemical versus structural contributions to aqueous solubility, enhanced by pretraining on large datasets and fine-tuning on smaller ones.
